subject.title: fix(matrix): honor abortSignal during startup whoami retry backoff

question: Should the shared plugin retry contract gain a supported abort-aware delay/signal hook for this and sibling startup retry paths, or should Matrix use an owner-local retry adapter?
rationale: The PR depends on a shared retry option that is not implemented by the current visible contract; choosing the permanent shared API boundary is an ownership decision, not a Matrix-only mechanical edit.

options.title: Add a shared retry hook
options.body: Extend the shared retry API with a typed abort-aware delay or signal mechanism, cover its behavior centrally, and retain the Matrix caller change.

options.title: Keep cancellation Matrix-local
options.body: Implement a Matrix-owned retry loop only if maintainers intentionally do not want cancellation semantics in the shared retry contract.

recommendation.title: Add a shared retry hook
recommendation.body: Extend the shared retry API with a typed abort-aware delay or signal mechanism, cover its behavior centrally, and retain the Matrix caller change.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and recently maintained the Matrix startup-backfill flow that requires this cancellation behavior.
